inputs.original_text: New York City’s sanctuary policies shouldn’t shield people from lawful immigration enforcement. An ICE arrest is not proof that whole communities are being targeted; it’s a reminder that public safety and respect for the law require authorities to do their jobs. Treating every enforcement action as an attack risks putting political ideology ahead of the safety and confidence of the public.
inputs.modified_text: New York City’s sanctuary policies send the wrong message when they interfere with lawful immigration enforcement. ICE making an arrest is not evidence that an entire community is under attack; it is the law being enforced. Leaders should put public safety, respect for national sovereignty, and confidence in lawful authority ahead of ideological posturing.
